name: Manyfold
tagline: An open source, self-hosted web application for managing a collection of 3D models, particularly focused on 3D printing.
description: Manyfold is an open source, self-hosted web application for managing a collection of 3D models, particularly focused on 3D printing.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/manyfold:0.150.0@sha256:5872d897cf181f9b5461bda49520ea32c0f2a0b75e485f6248673829a31d4d52
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      DATABASE_URL: ''
      REDIS_URL: ''
      SECRET_KEY_BASE: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3214
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/libraries
        target: /libraries
